note: Simulated: the lab stands in for an independent inspection lab. It reads each sampled board's board.json, where a real lab would X-ray the board and read the parts' markings under a microscope, and challenges each identity part as a real lab would over its debug port.
technique: 2D and 3D X-ray of each board, optical inspection of every component marking, and an identity challenge of each part that has one

simulated.simulator: hslsa inspect boards, reading each sampled board's simulated board.json and challenging its identity parts (tools/hslsa/inspect.go)
simulated.standsIn: an independent lab's X-ray, marking inspection and identity challenge of sampled boards
